purpose: Differential-oracle corpus for heredoc-in-$()/<()/backquote shapes (BR2-2-REG3, 2026-10-17). Each cmd has rm -rf /etc as its stand-in. runs53/runs32 were measured with bash 5.3.20 and bash 3.2.57 by bash -n + a ;; command-position differential on a never-called function wrapping the shape with a harmless stand-in (NEVER executed). The generator and labeller are in the repository (test/heredoc-oracle/generate.js and label.sh; regenerate with `generate.js probes <dir>`, `label.sh <dir>`, `generate.js corpus <labels>`); test-hooks.js re-derives the shapes and asserts these rows match them. A shape with runs53 OR runs32 true is one that at least one bash would run the removal on, so the guard must DENY it. Not covered: every heredoc body here is a plain word (body0, body1, ebody), so a later body holding a quote or a heredoc operator is in the separate later-body corpus (test-hooks-heredoc-later-body-corpus.json; KNOWN-RESIDUALS.md R7-a, closed in round 4b); its 20 backquote rows (o-backtick) all close the substitution after an exact delimiter line, so a heredoc whose delimiter line carries the closing backquote is outside it too (R7-b, still open).
